task_description: Fix the MPS Flexi HTML calculator to use actual non-linear rates from the JSON (absolute kontribusi per UP level), standardize Syariah terminology (Uang Santunan, Kontribusi, Peserta for Plan A & B), implement berdasar kontribusi mode showing estimated Uang Santunan, and add floating WhatsApp icon.

verification.summary: All verification checks pass. HTML well-formed (83 divs balanced). PREMI_DATA contains non-linear absolute kontribusi values keyed by UP level (all integers, no floating-point noise). Syariah terminology correctly used for Plan A/B (Uang Santunan, Kontribusi, Peserta) and conventional terms for Plan C (UP, Premi, Nasabah). Dynamic term switching. Floating WA icon at bottom-right. Calculator supports both 'berdasar UP' (dynamically filtered dropdown) and 'berdasar kontribusi' (interpolation) modes. Age interpolation for missing ages. Tabel Premi shows all 12 plan/currency/gender combinations. File size 717KB (342KB excluding komisi base64). Review v2 issues fixed: UP dropdown now filtered, all Tabel Premi buttons present.
